chunks: Whoever dies without leaving behind a successor, it is as if he had not been among the people. And whoever dies while having a successor, it is as if he did not die.

key_terms.النَّاسِ: the people; society or human community
key_terms.خَلَفٍ: a successor or offspring left behind after one's death
key_terms.مَاتَ: died; passed away from worldly life
key_terms.يَمُتْ: he dies; here, negated figuratively to indicate ongoing legacy

ai.seo_question: What does the hadith say about dying without leaving behind children or successors?
ai.summary: This hadith emphasizes the virtue and lasting value of leaving behind offspring or successors. It portrays one's continuity through descendants as a form of enduring presence among people.
